data.one_liner: Web platform implementation of video_player with HLS support.
data.what_it_does: Provides web support for the video_player plugin, enabling HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) playback on Chrome and other web browsers using hls.js.
use_when: You need to play HLS (.m3u8) video streams on Flutter Web
You are using the standard video_player package and targeting the web platform
avoid_when: You want to load videos from local files on the web (dart:io is not supported)
strengths: Brings HLS stream playback capability to Flutter web
Falls back to hls.js when native player fails
weaknesses: Does not support dart:io on the web (VideoPlayerController.file throws UnimplementedError)
Requires manual script addition to index.html
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the hls.js script tag to index.html before main.dart.js.
